app.name: ERP workspace
page.title: %s – %s
nav.label: Main
layout.help: Need help? Contact your company's ERP administrator.
language.name: English
home.title: Your workspace
home.notice.title: The jobs' screens are coming
home.notice.body: You are signed in. The screens for the pilot's jobs follow in the next versions of the workspace.
home.jobs.title: Coming to the workspace

home.jobs.count.one: %d job is planned for the pilot.
home.jobs.count.other: %d jobs are planned for the pilot.

status.title: Service status
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: The page you asked for does not exist, or is not yours to see.
home.companies.title: Your companies
home.companies.none: You have no company to work in yet. Ask your company's ERP administrator for access.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.lead: Enter your company's sign-in code. You will then sign in at your company's own identity provider.
signin.code.label: Sign-in code
signin.code.hint: Your administrator gives you the code. It is also the last part of the sign-in address you were sent.
signin.invalid: A sign-in code has 2 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
signin.unknown: No company uses this sign-in code. Check it with your administrator.
signin.error.title: There is a problem
signin.failed.title: Sign-in could not be completed
signin.failed.body: Your company's identity provider did not confirm the sign-in, or it took too long. Start again.
signin.unavailable: Signing in is not possible right now. Try again in a few minutes.
signin.stepup.body: Your company requires a second factor for this, and your identity provider did not confirm one. Sign in again with your second factor.
continue.title: Continue to your workspace
continue.body: Your browser is taking you to the page. If nothing happens, use the link.
signedout.title: You are signed out
signedout.body: Your session in the workspace has ended. To be sure no one else can use it, close the browser if you share this computer.
refused.title: This request was refused
refused.body: It did not carry the page's security token, or it came from another site. Go back, reload the page and try again.
inbox.title: Approvals waiting for you
inbox.lead: The requests you may decide now, newest first. Open one to see its steps and decide it.
inbox.empty: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
inbox.list.label: Requests waiting for you
inbox.barred.title: Your approvals are on hold
inbox.barred.body: You hold permissions that a segregation-of-duties rule keeps apart, so you cannot use them until an administrator removes one of them:
inbox.done.title: Decision recorded
inbox.refused.title: The approval requests could not be shown
agent.text: An agent wrote this. It is shown as plain text: check it before you decide.
request.title: Approval request
decide.title: Your decision
decide.comment.label: Comment (optional)
decide.comment.hint: At most 2,000 characters. It is recorded with your approval.
decide.reason.label: Reason for rejecting
decide.reason.hint: Required, at most 2,000 characters. The requester sees it.
decide.comment.long: A comment has at most 2,000 characters.
decide.own: You asked for this approval. Someone else decides it.
decide.notyours: You may not decide this request: it needs the step's role and the permission to approve this kind of object.
decide.closed: Nothing is left to decide: the request is no longer waiting.
refusal.title: The decision was not recorded
problem.workflow.already_approved: You have already approved this request. The next approval is someone else's.
problem.workflow.not_pending: This request is no longer waiting for a decision.
problem.workflow.own_request: You asked for this approval, so you cannot decide it.
problem.workflow.role_missing: You do not hold the role this step needs.
problem.workflow.segregation_of_duties: You took part in this work, so segregation of duties keeps you from approving it.
problem.workflow.request_pending: Another approval for the same object is still waiting.
problem.request.version_mismatch: The request changed since you opened it. Check it again, then decide.
problem.identity.permission_missing: You do not have the permission this needs.
problem.identity.sod_conflict: A segregation-of-duties rule bars this: you hold permissions it keeps apart.
problem.identity.agent_not_allowed: Only a person may decide approvals.
problem.request.not_found: The request does not exist, or is not yours to see.
problem.request.invalid_body: The decision could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
problem.request.validation_failed: Something in the decision is not valid. Check the comment and try again.
problem.request.idempotency_key_reused: This form was already sent with other content. Reload the page and decide again.
problem.ledger.period_not_open: The posting period is not open, so the entry cannot be posted on approval.
invoices.title: Supplier invoices
invoices.lead: Supplier invoices, latest invoice date first. Choose a status, or filter by company, supplier, number or date; open an invoice to match, post or decide it.
invoices.list.label: Supplier invoices
invoices.refused.title: The invoices could not be shown
filter.supplier: Only the invoices of one supplier:
filter.date.invalid: Enter a date as year-month-day, for example 2026-03-10.
filter.invalid: A filter in the address is not valid. Clear the filters and choose them again.
invoice.title: Supplier invoice
invoice.order.none: None: the invoice is posted to accounts
invoice.agent: An agent entered this invoice from a document. It is a proposal: check it against the document before you post it.
lines.title: Lines
lines.label: The invoice's lines
match.title: Three-way match
match.noorder: The invoice is not on a purchase order, so it is not matched.
match.clean: The latest match is clean: no issue.
match.issue.tax_or_total_mismatch: The tax or the total does not add up
match.issue.order_item_missing: The order has no such item
match.issue.price_variance: The price differs from the order beyond the tolerance
match.issue.quantity_exceeds_received: More is invoiced than was received
order.title: Purchase order and goods receipts
order.show: Show the purchase order and its goods receipts
receipts.title: Goods receipts
receipts.label: The order's goods receipts
order.refused.title: The purchase order could not be shown
document.title: Document
document.frame: The document the invoice was captured from
document.open: Open the document on its own
document.none: The invoice was not captured from a document, so there is none to show.
recs.title: Agents' recommendations
recs.none: No agent has recommended anything for this invoice.
recs.hint: A recommendation changes nothing by itself. Take the action yourself, or decide the exception's approval request, then record what you did with the recommendation.
recs.refused.title: The recommendations could not be shown
rec.kind.request_credit_note: Ask the supplier for a credit note
rec.decide.legend: What did you do with this recommendation?
rec.decide.required: Choose what you did with the recommendation.
rec.notyours: You may not decide agents' recommendations.
actions.title: What you can do
actions.none: Nothing is left to do on this invoice.
actions.notyours: You may not change this invoice in its status.
actions.pending: An exception's approval request is linked to the invoice. While it waits, someone who may approve it decides it in the approvals inbox, and releasing or cancelling the invoice by hand withdraws it; an invoice released by hand is matched again before it posts.
action.match.hint: Compares the invoice with its order and receipts. Issues put it on hold for an approval.
action.post.date.hint: Year-month-day. Empty: the invoice's posting date, or today. Its period must be open.
action.reason.hint: Required, at most 2,000 characters. It is recorded in the audit trail.
action.reverse.date.hint: Year-month-day. Empty: today. Its period must be open.
action.date.invalid: Enter a date as year-month-day, for example 2026-03-15.
invoice.refused.title: The invoice was not changed
invoice.done.title: Done
invoice.done.matched: The invoice was matched. The result is below.
invoice.done.released: The invoice is released from hold.
invoice.done.decided: Your decision on the recommendation is recorded.
problem.invoice.version_mismatch: The invoice changed since you opened it. Check it again, then try again.
problem.invoice.not_found: The invoice or the recommendation does not exist, or is not yours to see.
problem.invoice.invalid_body: The form could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
problem.invoice.validation_failed: Something in the form is not valid. Check it and try again.
problem.invoice.idempotency_key_reused: This form was already sent with other content. Reload the page and try again.
problem.invoice.request_pending: The invoice's exception waits for its approval request. Decide the request first, in the approvals inbox.
problem.invoice.period_not_open: The posting period is not open. Choose a date in an open period, or ask for the period to be opened.
problem.invoice.agent_not_allowed: Only a person may decide an agent's recommendation.
problem.payables.match_outdated: Documents posted on the order since the match change its result. Match the invoice again, then post it.
problem.payables.match_required: The invoice needs a clean match, or an approved exception, as it now stands. Match it first.
problem.payables.tax_mismatch: The tax amount does not agree with the tax calculated at the lines' tax codes. Correct the invoice, then try again.
problem.payables.invalid_status: The invoice's status does not allow this any more. The page shows it as it is now.
problem.payables.amounts_mismatch: The gross amount is not the lines' net amounts plus the tax. Correct the invoice first.
problem.payables.supplier_not_usable: The supplier is blocked for posting in this company.
problem.payables.no_purchase_order: The invoice is not on a purchase order, so there is nothing to match.
problem.payables.invoice_cleared: The invoice is paid or cleared, so it cannot be reversed.
problem.payables.invoice_in_payment_run: The invoice is in a payment run, so it cannot be reversed now.
problem.agents.already_decided: Someone has already decided this recommendation.
filter.number.hint: The ERP's document number, for example SI100001.
